name: Leonidas
who: Leonidas I, king of Sparta (c. 540-480 BC), about 60 at Thermopylae
design_source: 'Leonidas' marble hoplite head from Sparta (c. 480-470 BC, Sparta Archaeological Museum): strong brow, straight nose, full beard; Herodotus 7.208-209: Spartans wore long hair and combed it before battle; transverse crest = officer (vase paintings)

look.headgear: bronze Corinthian helmet pushed up, transverse red crest

signature: long combed hair under the helmet
